description: This Java class serves as a wrapper for summarizing various transaction-related calculations for a SavingsAccount, such as total deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, penalties, overdraft interest, and withhold tax. It operates over a list of SavingsAccountTransactionData objects and calculates totals using the Money class.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionDataSummaryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring component providing methods to compute summary totals over transactions related to a savings account without side effects.

methods.name: calculateTotalDeposits
methods.description: Calculates total deposit and dividend payout amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithdrawals
methods.description: Calculates total withdrawal amounts from transactions that are not reversed and are not reversal transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalInterestPosted
methods.description: Calculates total interest posting amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithdrawalFees
methods.description: Calculates total withdrawal fee amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalAnnualFees
methods.description: Calculates total annual fee amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalFeesCharge
methods.description: Calculates total fee charge amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalFeesChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates total waived fee charge amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Calculates total penalty charge amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalPenaltyChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates total waived penalty charge amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalOverdraftInterest
methods.description: Calculates total overdraft interest amounts from transactions that are not reversed.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithholdTaxWithdrawal
methods.description: Calculates total withhold tax amounts from withdrawal transactions that are not reversed.
